'''Showdown With An Assassin''' (Japanese: '''立ちはだかる刺客''' ''Assassin Blocking the Way'') is the sixth chapter of the [[Phantom Thief Pokémon 7]] manga.

{{incomplete plot}}

* [[Hiori]] defeats the Galactic Grunt.
* Hiori and [[Rocco]], while on their way to the [[Team Galactic]] headquarters, are attacked by another Team Galactic Grunt who is also defeated.
